svg.text: Appsec Large Verification Target · 0.0.1-SNAPSHOT · 21 components · 30 data flows · 12 trust boundaries (4 inferred) · 64 threats

g.title: Trust boundary crossing: tb-1 External → C-02; tb-2 External → C-03; tb-3 External → C-08; tb-4 External → C-01; tb-5 External → C-04; tb-6 External → C-05; tb-7 External → C-06; tb-8 External → C-10; tb-9 External → C-09; tb-10 External → C-07; tb-17 C-06 → External
Trust boundary crossing: tb-16 C-07 → C-15

df-001: HTTP GET login page render (HTTP) df-030: GET /actuator/** — Spring actuator endpoints exposed without authentication (HTTP) df-001 authentication: GET /login is in SecurityConfig permitAll list; no credential check; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/config/SecurityConfig.java:1, src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/web/WebUiController.java:41 df-030 authentication: /actuator/** is in SecurityConfig permitAll list, exposing environment, config, heap dumps, and health info; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/config/SecurityConfig.java:33

df-002: POST /login — Spring Security form login (password auth) (HTTP) df-003: POST /login — SQLite legacy auth path (HTTP) df-002 authentication: Spring Security UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter processes the form POST; CredentialLoggingFilter logs cleartext credentials before processing; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/authentication/CredentialLoggingFilter.java:1, src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/config/SecurityConfig.java:1 df-002 access group: Login path alternatives; alternatives; step n/a df-003 authentication: LegacySqliteAuthController.login at POST /login reads credentials and queries SQLite store; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/authentication/LegacySqliteAuthController.java:25 df-003 access group: Login path alternatives; alternatives; step n/a

df-004: POST /register — open self-registration (HTTP) df-005: GET /signed-jwt/token — signed JWT issuance (HTTP) df-006: GET /homegrown-token — Base64 session token issuance (HTTP) df-004 authentication: GET and POST /register are in SecurityConfig permitAll list; no prior authentication required; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/authentication/RegistrationController.java:40 df-005 authentication: No authentication check; confirmed by T-015 (evidence-verified); evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/authentication/AuthController.java:37 df-006 authentication: No authentication check; confirmed by T-015 (evidence-verified); evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/authentication/AuthController.java:37

df-007: GET/POST /legacy/admin/** — unauthenticated admin board (HTTP) df-007 authentication: /legacy/admin/** is in SecurityConfig permitAll list; LegacyAdminBoardController applies no authentication; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/config/SecurityConfig.java:1, src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/legacyadmin/LegacyAdminBoardController.java:22

df-008: GET/POST /api/orders — order access (IDOR surface) (HTTP) df-009: GET/POST /api/documents — document access (IDOR surface) (HTTP) df-008 authentication: OrderAccessController at /api/orders; authn_signal unknown; IDOR via direct ID access without ownership check; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/accesscontrol/OrderAccessController.java:14 df-009 authentication: DocumentDecisionController at /api/documents; authn_signal unknown; no ownership check on document access; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/accesscontrol/DocumentDecisionController.java:15

df-010: GET/POST /api/admin and /api/admin/users — admin report and user management (HTTP) df-010 authentication: AdminReportController and AdminUserController; missing_auth_suspect=true; no authentication check found; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/accesscontrol/AdminReportController.java:14, src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/accesscontrol/AdminUserController.java:12

df-011: GET/POST /documents — document management UI (file upload surface) (HTTP) df-012: GET/POST /orders — order management UI (HTTP) df-011 authentication: DocumentManagementController at /documents; missing_auth_suspect=true; file upload without extension/type validation; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/web/DocumentManagementController.java:60 df-012 authentication: OrderManagementController at /orders; missing_auth_suspect=true; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/web/OrderManagementController.java:61

df-013: GET/POST /admin/users — admin user management page (HTTP) df-013 authentication: AdminUsersPageController at /admin/users; missing_auth_suspect=true; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/web/AdminUsersPageController.java:46

df-014: GET /api/crypto endpoints — crypto/OTP/token operations (HTTP) df-014 authentication: CryptoController and CustomCryptoController; no authentication check found in route extraction; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/crypto/CryptoController.java:11

df-015: GET /search — SQL injection surface (document and order search) (HTTP) df-015 authentication: DocumentSearchController and OrderSearchController; no authentication check detected; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/inputvalidation/DocumentSearchController.java:24, src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/inputvalidation/OrderSearchController.java:23

df-016: POST /preview — XXE via unauthenticated XML parse endpoint (HTTP) df-016 authentication: XmlPreviewController.preview at POST /preview; missing_auth_suspect=true; no authentication check; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/serverside/XmlPreviewController.java:20

df-017: HTTP GET to user-supplied URL — SSRF via RestTemplate (HTTP) df-017 authentication: IntegrationController fetches caller-supplied URL with no allowlist or authentication; outbound request carries no application credential; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/serverside/IntegrationController.java:15

df-018: GET /landscape — landscape management page (authenticated) (HTTP) df-020: GET /api/landscape SVC-01..SVC-30 service endpoints (role-protected) (HTTP) df-018 authentication: LandscapePageController uses middleware_present signal; Spring Security session cookie required to view catalog; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/landscape/LandscapePageController.java:25 df-020 authentication: LandscapeServiceController routes R-093..R-115; middleware_present + decorator_present; @PreAuthorize role guards on each exposed service endpoint; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/landscape/LandscapeServiceController.java:30

df-019: POST /landscape/services/{serviceCode}/status — lifecycle state change (role-protected) (HTTP) df-019 authentication: LandscapePageController.updateStatus at POST /landscape/services/{serviceCode}/status; decorator_present signals @PreAuthorize with ROLE_OPERATIONS or ROLE_TENANT_ADMIN; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/landscape/LandscapePageController.java:36

df-023: JDBC query — user credential lookup in SQLite legacy store (JDBC) df-023 authentication: LegacySqliteUserStore accesses SQLite file directly via JDBC; no application-level auth on the store connection; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/authentication/LegacySqliteUserStore.java:1

df-024: JPA query — AppUser lookup and session data (JDBC) df-024 authentication: AppUserRepository JPA queries against embedded H2; no external auth on embedded store; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/domain/AppUserRepository.java:1

df-025: JPA CRUD — document and order records via Spring Data (JDBC) df-025 authentication: DocumentRecordRepository and CustomerOrderRepository JPA access to embedded H2; no external auth on embedded store; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/domain/DocumentRecordRepository.java:1, src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/domain/CustomerOrderRepository.java:1

df-026: Native SQL queries — vulnerable string concatenation in DocumentLookupDao and OrderLookupDao (JDBC) df-026 authentication: DocumentLookupDao and OrderLookupDao execute native SQL via EntityManager without parameterization; embedded H2 requires no connection auth; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/inputvalidation/DocumentLookupDao.java:1, src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/inputvalidation/OrderLookupDao.java:1

df-027: JPA CRUD — order, document, user records via Spring Data (IDOR surface) (JDBC) df-027 authentication: OrderAccessController and DocumentDecisionController use JPA repositories against embedded H2 without ownership enforcement; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/accesscontrol/OrderAccessController.java:1, src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/accesscontrol/DocumentDecisionController.java:1

df-028: JPA CRUD — vault_credentials table storing reversibly encrypted passwords (JDBC) df-028 authentication: VaultCredentialRepository persists reversibly encrypted secrets to H2 vault_credentials table; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/crypto/VaultCredentialRepository.java:1

df-029: JPA — landscape service catalog and invocation counts in PostgreSQL (JDBC) df-029 authentication: LandscapePersistence JPA aggregates; connection credentials from deployment environment variables; evidence: src/main/java/com/example/appsecverificationtarget/landscape/persistence/LandscapePersistence.java:1

Authenticated admin or operations user with elevated roles (ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_OPERATIONS, ROLE_TENANT_ADMIN). Accesses admin user management and landscape lifecycle endpoints.
External HTTP service reached by serverside-integration via SSRF-vulnerable RestTemplate. Represents any URL the attacker can supply to IntegrationController.
